description: Use this skill when the user has an existing .pptx file to work with — reading, parsing, extracting text/content, editing, modifying, or converting it. This includes: extracting text or speaker notes from a .pptx file, editing or updating slides in an existing presentation, combining or splitting .pptx files, working with templates/layouts/comments in .pptx format, converting .ppt to .pptx, and generating thumbnails or PDF exports from .pptx files. Trigger when the user provides a .pptx/.ppt file path or explicitly asks to read/edit/convert an existing presentation file. Do NOT use this skill for creating new presentations from scratch based on a topic — use ppt-implement instead.
